title: Solana launches onchain governance and sets entry fee at 100,000 SOL staked
summary: Validators and the people who stake with them can now formally signal where the network should go through a new system called Solana Governance Proposals. Any validator with 100,000 SOL behind it can open one, and stakers can overrule how their validator votes.
